_doc: RGB30 (RK3566). Image names, src offsets/sizes (sfdisk -d <image>; for the dArkOS/ArkOS images their p3/p4) and dtb paths are tied to specific image releases: re-check them when an image is updated.
name: RGB30
_key_pins: Vol-, Vol+ (GPIO3_B0, GPIO3_A7); also the order keys are handed out
_boot: knulli's mainline U-Boot (2024.07) runs boot.scr from BOOTSEL, even when knulli is not installed
_images: file names in img/; * matches any text (the newest matching file, by modification time, is used); a plain name pins one file
_src: partitions copied from each image, in order: ["pN", start, size, what]: partition N of the image; start/size (sectors) are read from the image's partition table when it is present (a difference is shown as NOTE in --plan) and are only the fallback
_dtb: from each OS's extlinux.conf (knulli, RGB30 v2 panel: boot/rk3566-rgb30-v2-linux.dtb)
